Operations Engineer (AI/HPC) 
 Role Overview
 Provides first- and second-line operational support for a large-scale AI and High-Performance Computing (HPC) platform. You will troubleshoot alerts, restore services, and maintain daily operations across Linux servers, Kubernetes, GPU clusters, networking, and storage , escalating complex faults to Senior Engineers.
 Work Setup: 100% remote (open to candidates residing in Poland, Hungary, Portugal, or Romania)
 Core Responsibilities
 Incident & Alert Response: Monitor system alerts, diagnose service failures, maintain clear ticket logs, and escalate major issues with detailed evidence.
 Linux & Kubernetes Operations: Troubleshoot unhealthy nodes, failed pods, resource bottlenecks, DNS/networking issues, and shared storage permissions.
 GPU & Hardware Maintenance: Monitor GPU health, isolate faulty nodes, run approved patching/reprovisioning runbooks, and coordinate hardware repairs with vendors.
 Compliance & Documentation: Execute approved user access/configuration changes under strict change control (GxP) and keep operational runbooks and automation scripts up to date.
 Must-Have Skills
 Linux & Containers: Hands-on production Linux administration (CLI diagnostics, logs, networking, storage mounts) and working knowledge of Kubernetes and containers.
 Networking & Storage: Solid grasp of TCP/IP, DNS, routing, and shared filesystems (like NFS).
 Troubleshooting & Scripting: Structured problem-solving using monitoring/ticketing tools, basic shell scripting, and familiarity with Git/version control.
 Nice-to-Have Skills
Experience with NVIDIA GPUs (CUDA, DCGM, GPU Operator, Run:ai) and AI/HPC workloads.
Familiarity with Prometheus/Grafana, Ansible, Python, Helm, GitOps , scale-out storage (e.g., VAST), and server BMC tools (e.g., HPE iLO).
